vuln_statements.explanation: This NLA policy definition for CTA_EXPECT_TUPLE attribute lacks proper nested attribute validation bounds. In nf_conntrack expectations, this allows unbounded nested tuple data to be parsed without sufficient length checking, potentially leading to memory corruption when processing malformed user-controlled netlink messages.

vuln_statements.stmt_text:
err = nla_parse_nested_deprecated(cda, CTA_EXPECT_MAX, attr,
					  exp_nla_policy, NULL);
vuln_statements.explanation: The nla_parse_nested_deprecated call uses exp_nla_policy to parse nested expectation attributes. If the policy doesn't properly validate all nested attribute types (particularly CTA_EXPECT_TUPLE and CTA_EXPECT_MASK), malformed input could bypass validation and cause memory corruption or privilege escalation through crafted netlink messages.
